g.text: Exercised only by the integration test

Same gap as ML-API-03 — implemented correctly, but nothing in this repository's backend, frontend, Dockerfile,
A failing smoke prediction on the current
snapshot is the one condition that can flip this
endpoint to not-ready without a restart.

svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
The only endpoint that can genuinely say 'stop sending this process traffic'.
